Don't let cyberattacks keep you down. Learn how Infinidat's enterprise cyber storage solutions can enable near-immediate recovery

Modern enterprises face escalating cyber threats. Rapid recovery is essential, with downtime potentially causing significant disruptions. Infinidat's InfiniSafe technology offers near-instantaneous recovery, ensuring resilience against cyberattacks.

VIDEO

Cyber-centric end-to-end data protection. Reducing the threat window using AI.

Cyber-focused data protection with threat reduction. Traditional backups can't ensure quick recovery. Discover how next-generation solutions enable high-speed, disruption-free cyber recovery—join Eric Herzog in the Register's Hot Seat to learn more.

Building the first and last lines of cyber defense

The report, "Building the first and last lines of cyber defense", surveys large organizations on their cybersecurity strategies, key technology investments, and how they prioritize data recovery and storage integration.

Green storage for the datacenter. A sustainable path to capex and opex savings

The article discusses strategies for datacenters to reduce energy consumption and carbon emissions through efficient storage systems, highlighting the importance of adopting green IT practices in the face of increasing data demands.

Embrace green IT in the data centre

Discover how Infinidat’s enterprise storage rchitecture helps data centres cut emissions, track power costs, and meet ESG goals. Join Eric Herzog in the Register’s hot seat to explore this green IT solution and potential savings.
